Growth & demand: Expansion & Strategic Growth In 1994, BALCO broadened its operational horizon and was formally incorporated as Solve Plastic Products Private Limited.

The company persistently pioneered new product lines and augmented its manufacturing capabilities: 1991: Established its inaugural manufacturing unit in Punalur, Kerala, laying the cornerstone for its future expansion.
2018: Responding to surging demand, a fourth manufacturing facility was instituted in Kannur, Kerala, ensuring seamless distribution and accessibility across key regions.
Margins & costs: The industry continued to witness challenges arising from volatile raw material prices, changing market conditions, and increasing competition.
